metric: Outcomes at risk by reason and age
definition: Count and value of grants, contributions and payments not progressing because of a hold, missing evidence, Unknown provider state or human decision, by reason and age band
calculation: count(subjects in blocked/unknown states) grouped by reason x age band; value = sum(amount)
authoritative_source: Grant, Payments, Contributions components (authoritative states) via read model
decision_supported: Where to direct staff and escalation
expected_action: Drill to exception inbox filtered by reason
thresholds: Age band breaches per case-profile clock
misleading_interpretations: Low count can mean detection gaps, not low risk (REQ-X-042)

metric: Straight-through rate by workflow, paired with sampled decision error rate
definition: Share of outcomes completed without a WorkItem, shown beside error rate found by independent sampling
calculation: completed_without_workitem / completed; paired with errors_in_sample / sample_size (CLM-005)
decision_supported: Whether automation scope can expand or must contract
expected_action: Approve or roll back rule changes through policy lifecycle
limitations: STP depends on mix of recipients
misleading_interpretations: High STP with unsampled errors is unsafe

metric: Cost per settled grant by rail (graded)
definition: Attributed operating cost per settled grant, by rail, with grade and range
calculation: sum(AttributedCost for grant activities)/count(settled grants), by rail; grade per UNB-XIN-ECO-003
limitations: Management estimate, not a financial statement
misleading_interpretations: Comparing grades A and D as equal
incentive_distortions: Shifting cost to charities (e.g. forcing ACH enrolment)

metric: Cost per account-month by balance band (graded)
definition: Attributed cost per open fund-month by balance band
decision_supported: Fee floor and servicing class decisions
thresholds: Fee revenue per account-month below cost in a band
misleading_interpretations: Read as profitability without revenue side

definition: Single weighted index of service, finance and compliance
keep: N — no decision; prohibited by UNB-UI-S-011 and the metrics architecture

definition: Amount and count of grants with settlement evidence
calculation: sum(amount where settlement evidence recorded in period)

definition: Total approved grant dollars
decision_supported: None not served by grants paid and outcomes at risk
limitations: Includes grants later returned or declined
keep: N — replaced by grants paid and outcomes at risk

definition: Total fund assets per named AssetMeasure version
Grants paid in trailing 12 months / average fund assets
decision_supported: Dormancy and activity policy; public accountability
misleading_interpretations: Not a legal requirement for DAFs

definition: Settled cash vs sponsor buffer floor per pool
misleading_interpretations: Cash in transit is not settled

definition: Count and value of payments in Unknown provider state by age

metric: Projected disbursement shortfall next N business days
definition: Projected opening balance minus scheduled outflows per disbursement account

metric: ACH return rates vs Nacha thresholds
definition: Rolling 60-day unauthorized, administrative and overall return rates
misleading_interpretations: Rate below threshold is not safety

definition: Accrued-unposted fees vs posted fees per period
thresholds: Any unexplained variance at period end

definition: Amount of minimum fees waived because fund capacity was insufficient
Sweep income not yet attributed

metric: Unexplained reconciliation breaks by class and materiality
definition: Open breaks not auto-cleared, by reconciliation class
calculation: count/sum where status=Break, by class and materiality tier
expected_action: Open exception; block statements for affected funds
misleading_interpretations: Zero breaks with stale feeds is not reconciled

definition: Business days from period end to close certification
misleading_interpretations: Fast close with sampled attestation skipped is not better

definition: Receipts not matched to an intent, by age
Funds with issued statement / funds eligible in cycle

definition: Posted corrections per 1,000 journals by cause

definition: Count of journals
keep: N — no decision; volume feeds capacity models internally only

definition: Reconciliation of Schedule D aggregate, statements and audited net assets
